selectedTargets.selectionReason: Early infusion-reaction action item paired with subsequent treatment, restart, and renal-toxicity stages; tests whether retrospective management details materially affect the initial bedside decision.
Documentation cloze compared with the authored infusion-reaction note and notification record; samples direct overlap between a keyed charting response and staged documentation.
Late AKI cue matrix using creatinine, urine output, and auditory findings; samples structured renal-toxicity evidence introduced after the infusion event.
Closing lisinopril decision during evolving AKI; tests whether serial renal findings are required evidence rather than merely adjacent chart data.
Opening refeeding-risk cue selection contrasted with later electrolyte collapse, intervention, and recovery; tests an early inference against a complete serial record.
Priority-response item at the severe hypophosphatemia stage, followed by documented protocol changes and response; samples action disclosure across adjacent stages.
Closing integration item spanning electrolyte trends, clinical response, and feeding progression; tests complete-record reasoning over multiple authored stages.
Initial prenatal privacy and screening response paired with later disclosure and safety planning; tests whether subsequent social-history facts alter the first interaction decision.
Therapeutic-communication cloze compared with the client's later disclosures and safety discussion; samples strong cueing without relying on repeated answer wording.
Safety-plan action item using the disclosed exit risk and planning stage; tests a late case decision that may legitimately depend on accumulated context.
Opening symptom-pattern item in a serial graft-versus-host case, paired with later diagnostic and treatment information; tests early diagnostic inference under full-stage visibility.
Middle priority item during clinical evolution, with later therapy and outcome evidence visible; samples whether post-decision information collapses prioritization.
Closing classification item integrating rash, gastrointestinal, hepatic, and response findings; tests intended full-progression use in a multi-system case.
Initial START-algorithm decision in a one-stage case whose update only announces responder arrival and applied tags; tests exposed but potentially nonanswering future context.
General disaster-triage principles item paired with the responder-arrival update; samples complete-record versus topic-adjacent stage information in a one-stage case.
Opening pyloric-stenosis and dehydration cue selection contrasted with later electrolyte and postoperative stages; tests whether confirmatory progression affects initial recognition.
Acid-base and electrolyte matrix aligned to the structured laboratory stage, with postoperative information also visible; samples necessary versus unrelated staged data.
Postoperative feeding decision explicitly situated after pyloromyotomy and feeding orders; tests a response demand tied to the final authored stage.
Initial preventive-screening matrix based on age and overdue history, contrasted with a later positive FIT and access barriers; tests nonanswering future-result exposure.
Instruction item explicitly triggered by the positive FIT in the sole follow-up stage; tests a stage-dependent diagnostic-follow-up decision.
Closing ordered counseling workflow combining barrier assessment, teaching, verification, scheduling, and documentation; samples complete-plan reasoning across initial and follow-up context.
Early transfusion-reaction cue-highlighting item contrasted with later differentiating hemodynamic, treatment, and response evidence; tests initial syndrome recognition.
TACO-versus-TRALI classification item with later comparator and intervention-response data visible; samples diagnosis disclosure through serial clinical evidence.
Closing management and evaluation item using the complete transfusion-reaction course; tests whether accumulated response evidence is intentionally required.
Opening thyroid-storm cue matrix contrasted with later treatment and adverse-effect information, including the case's visual or trend surface; tests early pattern recognition.
Later PTU-safety decision explicitly scoped to the 1200 record; samples a response demand that should be evaluated against its named stage.
Middle postoperative opioid-depression action item followed by documented reversal and subsequent status; tests whether outcome evidence confirms the immediate intervention.
Closing monitoring item after naloxone response and ongoing risk; tests complete-course evaluation of recurrence and observation needs.
Opening consent-validity decision before qualified interpretation, contrasted with later procedure hold and renewed consent; tests retrospective confirmation of an ethical action.
Final consent documentation item after interpreter-supported re-consent; samples a response demand tied to the completed legal and communication sequence.
Opening prerenal-AKI and hyperkalemia cue classification contrasted with later treatment and serial laboratory trends; tests early inference under full progression.
Closing response-and-risk matrix integrating renal function, potassium, urine output, and treatment course; tests intended use of the complete staged record.
